title: Agents manifest
description: The normative description of `.agents/manifest.yaml` (ADR 0015 §2). The manifest states which harnesses are enabled and which version of the format the directory is written against; everything else about a harness lives in its own document.

specVersion.description: Version of the `.agents/` format this directory is written against, validated against the same set as a harness document's `spec_version` (ADR 0015 §4, partially superseded by ADR 0019 §6). Note the spelling: this field is camelCase while its harness counterpart is snake_case, an inconsistency that predates the schema and is preserved rather than corrected.

enabled.description: What the runtime should load. Absent means nothing is enabled.

harnesses.description: Harness identifiers to load, each resolved against `.agents/harnesses/<id>/harness.yaml`.
